channel.title: Input
channel.description: Updates for Input, the six-key braille keyboard for Windows.

item.title: Input 0.1.0
item.description:
Important

  • Initial release.
  • Requires Windows 10 or newer.

Fixes & Improvements

  • Six-key braille input (Perkins-style) with UEB Grade 1 and Grade 2.
  • Grade 1 types live, cell by cell; Grade 2 commits the whole word.
  • Braille View window with a title bar: drag to reposition (remembered), right-click anywhere for the full menu.
  • Ctrl+Alt+B toggles braille mode; works over any focused app.
